integrity: All finite enumerations are independent corroboration of the supplied human-readable proof. No independent audit performed; no inference from experimental samples to unrestricted statements.
scientific_limitations: Complete equality-set classification obtained for ternary ranks one and two only; for rank at least three a quotient reduction and explicit index-three subgroup family are proved, not completeness. Indexed literature comparisons cannot prove absolute priority. Nonindependent verification.
title: Sharp equality rigidity for projective three-cube-free sets in odd abelian groups
